name: Glutamates
aliases: E620, E621, E622, E623, E624, E625, glutamate, glutamates, glutamic acid, L-glutamic acid, monosodium glutamate, MSG, sodium glutamate, monopotassium glutamate, potassium glutamate, calcium diglutamate, calcium glutamate, monoammonium glutamate, ammonium glutamate, magnesium diglutamate, magnesium glutamate
what_is: A group of flavour-enhancing food additives comprising glutamic acid (E620) and its sodium, potassium, calcium, ammonium and magnesium salts (E621–E625).
why_botia: BOTIA flags them because E620–E625 are declared flavour enhancers that can appear under either an E number or a specific ingredient name, including monosodium glutamate (E621/MSG).
can_1: Identify E620–E625 and their common declared names, including monosodium glutamate (MSG/E621).
can_2: Trigger the flavour and E-number information layers when one of these additives is declared.
cannot_1: Determine the amount present from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Infer total dietary glutamate exposure or predict an individual's response from the presence of one declared glutamate additive.
